answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by the compliance hold on the security patch, so memory_b1's playbook is unavailable. The latency is on the write path, so read-replica routing (memory_b5) likely offers little relief, though I want to verify it before dismissing it. The degradation is confined to the primary region, which matches the conditions where regional failover (memory_b2) previously restored latency within minutes without data loss. Failover shifts both reads and writes to a healthy region, preserving customer writes while addressing the 5x p99. Risks: failover during peak settlement traffic carries replication-lag/write-conflict risk, so I flag downstream value risk and want the archived record for b2 to confirm the failover was clean under write load. Confidence is moderate pending verification of b2 and confirmation that replication lag is low enough to avoid losing in-flight writes.
